maria_ng: Heads up — after the quantized HF->Redwood import of mosaic-3b-v1 the chat output keeps truncating mid-sentence and we see PAD tokens inserted randomly. Repro on staging.
samir: oof. any logs/snippets? that's usually a special-token id issue.
maria_ng: paste: `added_tokens.json` looks normal but there's an extra null-like entry at index 5021. also config.json doesn't include explicit special_tokens_map.
kevin_w: can you dump the first 5200 token strings + ids? curious if insertion order changed during tokenizer.merge or byte-level normalization.
maria_ng: here's a tiny diff I ran (trimmed):
```
- token[5009] = "<|pad|>"
- token[5021] = "\u00A0"  # non-breaking-space was added by user token list
+ after convert:
+ token[5009] = "<|pad|>"
+ token[5021] = "<|pad|>"  # duplicate mapping -> id collision
```
samir: whoa duplicate mapping. HF tokenizer's `added_tokens.json` keeps insertion order but during our conversion the script builds a new vocab dict and uses `set()` on tokens in one step, which can reorder when deduping. That would shift downstream ids.
convert-bot: Conversion job 2543219876-3 completed. Warnings: duplicate tokens detected; fallback applied: reassigning token ids.
kevin_w: Also noticed byte-level normalization: HF saved tokens with NFKC vs our conversion expecting NFC. So U+00A0 vs regular space became distinct tokens, then later dedup collapsed them to same string in Python 3.11 canonicalization pass.
maria_ng: Nice catch. Explains why pad got a second id and some ids slid by +1 in the tail.
samir: Short term mitigation: in the conversion script, preserve original token order and do not dedupe by naive set(). Also persist explicit `special_tokens_map` from HF `config.json` into Redwood `config` before reindexing.
kevin_w: I wrote a small patch. Key bits:
```
# preserve order and explicit specials
tokens = json.load(open('added_tokens.json'))
seen = {}
ordered = [seen.setdefault(t, t) for t in tokens if t not in seen]
# map special tokens first
for sname, sval in hf_config.get('special_tokens_map', {}).items():
    assign_id_for(sname, sval)  # reserve ids before enumerating rest
```
maria_ng: Can you push that patch to the conversion repo? After that we'll re-run quant pipeline.
convert-bot: PR #279 opened by kevin_w: "preserve-order and special token reservation in hf->redwood import".
ops_bot: Running full import + quant job 2543219876-4. ETA ~14m.
samir: For longer term: add a post-import sanity-check that verifies `pad`, `bos`, `eos`, `unk` IDs match the ones listed in HF tokenizer files and fail conversion if any drift > 0.
aria_ng: (typo) I meant maria_ng :)
maria_ng: also note: models with custom user-defined added_tokens (emoji, nbsp) are common — we should normalize/escape control whitespace before dedupe and include normalization mode in conversion metadata.
kevin_w: Agreed. I'll add a converter flag `--normalization-mode` and write small eval that runs a prompt set to ensure no quality regression after id remap.
samir: filed ENG-ML ticket ENG-2047 with reproducer + suggested fix. referencing PR #279. tagging QA for regression tests.
maria_ng: thanks. will validate logs once job finishes. :thumbsup:
kevin_w: quick note — if you see mid-sentence <|pad|> the symptomatic fix is to confirm `pad_token_id` in model config points to the same id as tokenizer's token for pad. we've had cases where model config carried an older id.
samir: yup, check `model.config['pad_token_id']` vs `tokenizer.pad_token_id` after conversion.
maria_ng: re-run complete: noise + truncation gone on first smoke test. no regressions on our prompt set. will run larger eval tomorrow.
convert-bot: Conversion job 2543219876-4 succeeded. Metrics: token-id-drift: 0, sanity-check: pass.
ops_bot: closing temporary staging run.
